armarPc.intro: Choose each part step by step. We only show the ones that are compatible with what you already picked, so you don't need to know about sockets or form factors.
armarPc.avisoQuitado: We removed {{nombre}} because it was no longer compatible: {{motivo}}.
armarPc.armadoDescartado: Your previous build had products that are no longer available, so we started over.
armarPc.errorValidar: We couldn't check compatibility. Please try again.

Motherboard.ayuda: It's the board everything plugs into. It decides which processor and memory you can use.

CPU.ayuda: It's the brain of the PC. We show the ones that fit your motherboard.

RAM.ayuda: More memory lets you keep more programs open at once. For gaming, 16 GB or more is recommended. You can pick several identical modules.

Gabinete.ayuda: It's the box that holds everything. The motherboard, graphics card and power supply must fit inside.

GPU.ayuda: It handles graphics: the most important part for gaming or video editing.

Almacenamiento.ayuda: It's where the system, programs and your files are stored. An NVMe SSD makes everything load much faster. You can add more than one drive, for example an NVMe for the system and a hard drive for your files.

Fuente.ayuda: It powers the whole computer. We only show the ones that are enough for what you picked, with a safety margin.

Perifericos.ayuda: Monitor, mouse, keyboard, headset... You can add several or skip this step.

armarPc.gpuOpcional: Optional: your processor has integrated graphics, so you can use the PC without a graphics card.
armarPc.conexionesMother: You can add several drives as long as they fit your {{nombre}}: it has {{m2}} M.2 slots and {{sata}} SATA ports.
armarPc.gpuObligatoria: Required: your processor has no integrated graphics, without a graphics card you won't get any picture.
armarPc.sinCompatibles: There are no products compatible with your choices. Try changing a part from a previous step.
armarPc.sinPerifericos: There are no products in this category.
armarPc.elegirIgualDetalle: Choosing this product removes {{nombres}} from your build
